owner_response.text:
Hafiz

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback

I am sorry to hear that you experienced further issues after our visit. We understand how frustrating drainage problems can be.

At the time of our inspection we carried out a camera assessment and cleared the build-up that was affecting the line. All drainage points we tested were flowing correctly before we left, and when followed up shortly after you confirmed everything was working as expected.

In some cases drainage systems can have underlying or developing blockages that aren’t fully apparent during an initial visit which can lead to issues reoccurring over time.

When you contacted us again, we did offer to return and reassess the system to help identify any deeper cause.

We always aim to provide an honest and thorough service with clear communication and we genuinely appreciate the opportunity to have assisted.

If you’d like to discuss this further I'm always here to help.

Kind regards,
Joel Project Plumbing

reviews.text:
It seems like we were on the wrong side of the coin with Project Plumbing's service. Nevertheless it's one worth sharing.

We were dealing with a pipe blockage issue causing very slow drainage, bad smells and loud blubbering noises around the house.

The guys showed up and inspected the pipes using a camera but didn't check every drainage point. They then suggested there was a grease build up and left the hot water running for an hour. That was the end of the service.

The service ended up costing $715. We thought this was overpriced for what was done, but as it seemed to have solved the issue we paid the bill immediately.

After 3 days, the same issue returned and we called the team to come have a look. This is where things took an odd turn as they suggested that this issue was completely unrelated to the old issue only 3 days earlier and would require an entirely new quote and call out fee. We found this to be quite unprofessional and lacking any goodwill.

We ended up calling another plumber who inspected every drainage point with a camera, found a large fatberg that had no way of forming in only 3 days and pressure blasted and cleaned our whole drainage system for almost the same amount that Project Plumbing charged us for a camera inspection and a little bit of hot water.

Overall, I'd suggest proceeding with a little bit of caution when going with their service. They seem to have a lot of great reviews which gave us encouragement but it isn't always a sign of an honest business.

reviews.text: bad first time tattoo experience with trongy, completely disregarded what I wanted to get done (forearm tattoo) and wanted to size up my arm for a full sleeve, showed up 45 minutes late to the appointment and doesn’t have very good communication.

Got a forearm piece done by Bimal. Amazing flow, bold lines, and insane attention to detail. Super professional and easy to sit with for long sessions. Couldn’t be happier with the result, highly recommend.
Very welcoming and friendly tattoo and piercing shop. Highly recommended 👍🏻👍🏻
First went here 4 years ago owner is lovely amazing kind soul. Went for a visit recently met Joey  Had a great experience with him and his crew

I had an awesome experience at Santeria Tattoos. The linework was absolutely spot on—super clean and precise, exactly what you want from a quality tattoo.
Cesar was the artist, and he nailed it. Not only is his work top quality, but he was great to chat with and made the whole experience feel easy and relaxed.
On top of that, the whole vibe was great. The team was really friendly, and it honestly felt more like hanging out for a good morning than just getting a tattoo.
Couldn’t be happier with how it turned out. Highly recommend if you’re looking for top-notch work and a welcoming atmosphere.

“Had a great experience with Joe. He’s welcoming, easy to talk to, and takes real care with his work. The tattoo turned out beautifully and the whole process was relaxed and positive. Would definitely go back.”

Got a tattoo done by Cesar in cyrillic absolutely nailed the design and final looks of the tattoo, very professional and clean shop with a great atmosphere.
thank you Cesar, absolute legend would highly recommend this shop!💯
Cesar and the guys are a pleasure to deal with and they do amazing work
Great prices and great tattoo pictures done by joey and cesai , would highly recommend
Amazing place love the vibe great prices. Santeria did my tattoo and I absolutely loved it. Just a great guy in general. If I get more tattoos I'll definitely be coming back

Joey is seriously a legend and I feel so lucky to have found him! 🖤 I’ve gotten 9 tattoos from him, and every single one has been such a fun experience. He’s not just incredibly talented  he’s also super chill, hilarious, and makes you feel like you’re hanging out with a friend rather than getting tatted. His good vibes are contagious, and I always look forward to my sessions with him. Even though he’s an apprentice, his skill is on another level, and it’s obvious he’s going to be one of the best in the game. I trust him with all my tattoos, and I couldn’t recommend him more! 💕

Been coming to see Joey for some ink a few times now , shop is super clean and awesome vibes. Each piece Joey has done has been everything I wanted and more , super talented and awesome dude. As someone who has had many ( up to tattoo #20 now ) I can confidently say Joey is one of the next best up and coming Melbourne artists. Will gladly sit in a chair at Santeria anytime !
Just 🔥🔥🔥
Just finished a session with Joey. Absolute legend of a human and am stoked with the finished product. Will be back!
Just had two tattoos done by joey.  They came out exactly the way I wanted. Very clean and very friendly. If I could give more than 5 stars I would.  Will definitely be back.

I’ve just finished a whole day sitting with Joey, amazing customer service and smashed out so much work within the 8 hours and 10 minutes of me being there!! Would highly recommend booking with him as I will definitely be back to get some more pieces done!!

Thank you JOEYY🥳🥳🫶🏽🫶🏽

One if best experience iv had, customer service is excellent, 100% recommend

I got a tattoo from Cesar at Santeria Tattoo last Monday, and the results surpassed my expectations. Cesar was knowledgeable, welcoming, and attentive throughout the process. It's been just over two weeks, and my tattoo is almost completely healed. I'm very happy with the entire experience and highly recommend Cesar for anyone looking to get a tattoo.

P.s, I feel like the photos I took don't do this tattoo justice
